core: Muscle calcium cycling controlling contraction and relaxation
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and negative cardiac chronotropy/inotropy
name: Cardiac calcium cycling via ryanodine receptor release
rationale: All members concern cytosolic/sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling that sets muscle contraction, relaxation and heart rate; unlike the confusables the theme includes ryanodine-receptor release regulation and negative regulation of heart rate and cardiac contraction.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER core loop with PPARA/PGC-1alpha metabolic outputs
name: BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER circadian clock loop and metabolic outputs
rationale: Members are the core clock activators/repressors, their phosphorylation, degradation and entrainment plus clock-coupled metabolic regulators (PPARA, PGC-1alpha, heme, REV-ERB/ROR); confusables carry the metabolic outputs but lack the core clock machinery.

core: Leukocyte polarization and immunological synapse signaling
qualifier: Vav1-Cdc42/Rho GTPase signaling
name: Vav1-Cdc42 signaling in T cell polarity and immune synapse
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, immune synapse, lymphocyte aggregation/homing and DC chemotaxis driven by Rho-family GTPase, Vav1 and PLC/PKC signaling; confusables instead emphasize CORO1A-DEF6, integrin adhesion or NADPH oxidase RHO effectors.

core: Transcriptional control of growth-suppressive and cadherin genes
qualifier: RUNX3 targets plus CDH1/CDH11 promoters
name: Transcriptional regulation of RUNX3 targets and cadherin genes
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulation of tumor-suppressive targets (RUNX3 on p14-ARF, BIM, CDKN1A; FOXO cell-cycle genes; TFAP2, TGFBR3) and of CDH1/CDH11; confusables lack either the RUNX3 target set or the cadherin promoter regulation.

qualifier: primordial germ cell migration, proliferation and meiotic entry
name: Primordial germ cell migration, proliferation and meiotic entry
rationale: All members concern early germ cell biology (PGC migration, proliferation, ectopic germ cell death, meiosis activation, maturation), whereas confusables are gonadal somatic/hormonal or oocyte maturation processes.

qualifier: DAP12 signaling, without amyloid-beta or apoptotic cell clearance
name: DAP12-mediated microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity
rationale: Members describe microglial/macrophage activation, migration, proliferation, cytotoxicity, fusion and neuron remodeling with DAP12 signaling; confusables add amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance that this theme lacks.

qualifier: via FRS2/3, PLCgamma1 and RAS adaptors
name: BDNF-TRKB signaling through FRS2, PLCgamma and RAS
rationale: All members are BDNF activation of NTRK2 and its FRS2/FRS3, PLCG1 and RAS branches; confusables carry the PI3K, CDK5, RAC1, NTF3 or NTRK3 branches instead.

core: Regional CNS patterning and neuron migration
qualifier: dorsoventral neural tube and spinal cord neuron fate specification
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuron subtype specification and migration
rationale: Members cover forebrain/cortex regionalization and interneuron migration together with spinal cord motor and interneuron fate specification and dorsoventral neural tube patterning; confusables share forebrain development but lack the spinal cord dorsoventral specification.

qualifier: dopamine receptor signaling, transporter reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug-reward behavior
rationale: Members span dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine transport/reuptake (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, ethanol and nicotine; confusables emphasize monoamine degradation, biosynthesis, serotonin or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: with cadmium transport and detoxification
name: Zinc and cadmium transmembrane transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are zinc influx/efflux (SLC39/SLC30), zinc homeostasis and starvation, plus cadmium transport and detoxification; confusables concern copper, manganese, iron or metallothionein/MTF1 responses.

qualifier: transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine with serine catabolism
name: Homocysteine transsulfuration and cysteine and serine catabolism
rationale: All members are steps of the transsulfuration route (serine plus homocysteine to cysteine) and cysteine/sulfur amino acid breakdown; confusables cover selenium, glycine, threonine or other amino acid catabolism.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins (GLP-1, GIP), fatty acid receptors and acetylcholine
name: KATP, incretin and fatty-acid control of insulin secretion
rationale: Members are beta-cell insulin secretion regulators: KATP channels and their disorders, GLP-1/GIP incretins, FFAR1 and fatty acid metabolism, acetylcholine; confusables add insulin processing or glucagon/adrenergic inhibition instead.

qualifier: keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, not melanocytes
name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and skin appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier, and hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary placode development; confusables add melanocyte and pigmentation biology.

qualifier: astrocytic uptake from the synapse
name: Synaptic glutamate reuptake into astrocytes
rationale: All three members concern clearance of glutamate by plasma membrane import, notably astrocytic uptake; confusables concern aspartate, monoamine or GABA transport.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: RNA viruses (coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV) rather than retroviral integration
name: RNA virus entry, genome replication, translation and assembly
rationale: Members span attachment/entry, genome replication, viral translation, protein maturation, assembly and host restriction for SARS-CoV, dengue, influenza and RSV; confusables are HIV reverse transcription/integration and herpesvirus latency.

qualifier: axonemal dynein arm assembly and sperm motility
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and sperm flagellar motility
rationale: Members concern motile cilia/flagella (dynein arms, central apparatus, cilium movement, mucociliary clearance) and sperm motility and midpiece formation; confusables focus on tubulin modifications or primary cilium trafficking.

qualifier: NOTCH1 intracellular domain including constitutive PEST/HD mutants
name: NOTCH1 intracellular domain transcription, including oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are Notch target transcription driven by the NOTCH1 ICD and its constitutively active PEST and HD+PEST mutants; confusables carry NOTCH2/3/4 transcription or upstream NOTCH1 activation steps.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation to PKA and CREB
name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis and degradation, adenylate cyclase activation, PKA and DARPP-32, and CREB phosphorylation; confusables emphasize adenylate cyclase inhibition, adrenergic signaling or CaMK-driven CREB.

qualifier: connexin assembly and trafficking
name: Connexin gap junction assembly, trafficking and communication
rationale: Members describe connexin oligomerization, secretory trafficking, gap junction formation/turnover and electrical/neuron-glia transmission; confusables concern ion channel regulation or axonal adhesion molecules.

qualifier: endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance rather than docking and fusion
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering, clathrin uncoating and active zone/cytoskeleton organization; the closest confusable instead covers vesicle docking, priming and fusion.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and early elongation
qualifier: promoter escape and pausing, including HIV Tat-mediated elongation
name: Pol II promoter escape and pausing, including HIV Tat
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation/capping, pausing and early elongation, including HIV Tat-regulated elongation; confusables are Pol I/III transcription or general transcription regulators.

qualifier: EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR mutants, amplifications and fusions
name: Oncogenic EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR variant signaling
rationale: Members are constitutive signaling by cancer variants of EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR1-3 (plus LTK); confusables center on PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK variants.

qualifier: NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 intracellular domains
name: Notch target transcription by NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4
rationale: Members are Notch target transcription and its context (Th2 differentiation, pancreatic bud, RUNX3 regulation) via NOTCH2/3/4 ICDs; confusables are NOTCH1 ICD transcription and NOTCH1 oncogenic mutants.

qualifier: with translation factor modification (hypusine, diphthamide, hydroxylation)
name: Translation termination, mRNA surveillance and translation factor modification
rationale: Members are termination, nonsense/no-go/non-stop decay and the post-translational modifications of translation factors (eIF5A hypusine, EEF2 diphthamide, hydroxylation); confusables involve methylation, tRNA modification/charging or initiation.

qualifier: serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling
name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling in gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members are serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gut smooth muscle contraction, gastric motility, acid secretion and stomach development; confusables are general smooth muscle, histamine or muscarinic signaling.
